title: Cheap fix T7: browser preview does not read Zotero
description: Follow team/PROTOCOL.md, DELEGATION.md Common rules (docs/agent-work/2026-10-24-delegation/DELEGATION.md lines 8-20) and the approved plan docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-cheap-fixes/PLAN.md; the task section named here is the spec (files, steps, acceptance check, fail-first, stop rules). Pinned Node; serial check slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) before expensive checks; production-preview Playwright on a free port 1500+; no installs/commits/pushes; register any extra path before editing; report CLAIMED with log paths; independent review required. Plan task T7 (owner default: remove the path): in src/research/zotero.ts fetchZoteroItems, when not desktop throw 'Zotero refresh works in the desktop app only.' before any network call; delete browserRead and constants only it used; ResearchPanel shows the message (theme variables, -- dashes); unit test spies globalThis.fetch and asserts no call; rewrite tests/zotero.spec.ts mocked-fetch cases to assert the message; keep URL-guard tests.

Diff: fetchZoteroItems runs URL guard then throws ZOTERO_DESKTOP_ONLY when !isNativeApp() before any network call; browserRead/readCappedText/TOO_LARGE/ZOTERO_TIMEOUT_MS/ZOTERO_MAX_BYTES gone (grep src empty); ZOTERO_PAGE_SIZE/MAX_PAGES present; native invoke('zotero_read',{request}) path byte-identical in behaviour; URL-guard tests kept. My runs (pinned Node 22.23.3, logs node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-cf7-review): vitest src/research 11 files/193 passed; tsc exit 0; fail-first with worker's vitest.old.config.mjs (zotero.old.ts = HEAD except absolute import paths) 1 failed/25 passed, the no-fetch test failing because old code called the fetch spy ('reading status'); private vite build (src was newer than dist due to T054) -> bundle has the desktop-only text and not the old 5 MiB message; production-preview Playwright port 1517 zotero+research specs --workers=1 12 passed; nothing listened on 23119/1517 before, port 1517 free after. Hashes match sha-final.txt. Coverage: removed unit tests for redirect/12s/5MiB/304/200-parse covered deleted browser code; the same limits and 304 stay covered by src-tauri/src/zotero.rs tests (no redirects, 12s, 5MiB cap, reports_not_modified_for_a_304); pagination re-covered via mocked invoke; new native-invoke test. Lost by design: browser e2e of the successful refresh flow (Import Zotero sources dialog, item-count status, Add sources, retention after Disconnect, truncation status text) -- now provable only in the desktop app (C3 owner synthetic-Zotero check). Minor: _options/abort signal unused, as the native path never used it before.
